# Readme Craft

Shape a clear, visual GitHub README that guides readers from first impression to first use.

[All skills](index.md) · [Collection overview](../../README.md) · [Research and inspiration](../../standards/framework-evidence.md)

## When to use it

Generate and improve README files using a 3-tier layout strategy, GitHub-native formatting patterns, badge guidance, and a state-driven workflow. Use when the user says "write a README", "generate a README", "create a README", "improve this README", "review my README", "make my README better", "add badges", or "fix my README layout".

Example request:

> Use readme-craft to improve this work using its complete upstream guidance.

Expected result: An output shaped by the complete upstream instructions, source material and the task at hand.

## Install and use

Install this skill from the versioned collection in a supported Agent Skills environment:

```sh
npx skills add https://github.com/theGeekist/skills/tree/v1.10.0 --skill readme-craft
```

Select the intended agent and installation scope when prompted. This CLI installation is separate from ChatGPT plugin registration and mobile availability. Client discovery and activation require their own verification.

Read the [complete skill instructions](../../skills/readme-craft/SKILL.md) and [bundled purpose reference](../../skills/readme-craft/references/GEEKIST-UPSTREAM.md) for the full conditions and exceptions.
